authorization: Owner requested resolution of crossings and ground calibration and regeneration through the capture pipeline.

calibration.basis: Game-authored ground-plane design scale under the owner instruction to resolve calibration: 2/3 m per source x pixel, 0.9 m per source y pixel, 24 m compilation margin. This stylized elevated concept has no survey. Controls are authored design coordinates, not independent real-world measurements. Roof outlines remain unbound; catalog sizes independently constrain buildings.

junctionPolicy: Explicit level-zero at-grade decisions for compiled roads; no invisible bridges or tunnels invented.
accessPolicy: Authored site access stubs connect exact captured-road points; original main-road points are unchanged.
services: External city-grid game services enter at the north gateway; shared capacities and shortest routes are evaluated by the C# engine.

scope.purpose: Generate the owner-requested Modern city road network and a representative stadium, heavy factory, logistics, school, offices and residential composition using reviewed ground design.
excludedContent: Unbound roof silhouettes and decorative objects remain reference-only, not collision footprints.
Remaining small streets, individual trees/furniture, roundabout lane detail and the complete visual building inventory are outside this generation scope.
Production sprite/atlas artwork and GameArts lifecycle approvals are separate.

limits: No surveyed dimensions, approved art profile, production sprites or Godot runtime asserted.
Source roof silhouettes remain separate from authored ground design.
siteBoundaryPolicy: Authored 2.1m maintenance/circulation insets on site bands keep adjacent building, yard, parking and planting surfaces distinct at the selected 2m raster resolution; building/catalog variant dimensions are preserved.
roadProfilePolicy: Modern cross-sections are authored functional profiles for the city network. Approximate source-pixel widths remain observations, not inferred engineering measurements.

compilationScope.purpose: Compile representative Modern city, eight source-bound park ground/sport surfaces and 44 fixed source tree positions. Paving is the explicit park ground between planting and sport polygons.
excludedContent: Unbound roof silhouettes and decorative objects remain reference-only, not collision footprints.

Remaining small streets, city-wide tree/greenery integration outside the park, furniture, lane detail and full building inventory remain outside this generation scope; their source annotations are retained separately.
Production sprite/atlas artwork and GameArts lifecycle approvals are separate.

detailedExtraction.treePlacement: Captured crown center is the tree base, per owner direction; same source coordinates.
detailedExtraction.remaining: Fine masks/components and city-wide collision acceptance remain open.
detailedExtraction.groundOwnership: All 44 park bases have a planted-ground parent; 1.5px authored base radius and protected source-road/sport polygons are capture-validated. Existing world clearance/raster gates additionally apply.

protected: full road corridors including curbs and sidewalks
surfaceSpacing.policy: Game-authored visual minimum. Original observed contours are retained separately from adjusted authored masks; tree positions are fixed.
surfaceSpacing.rasterLimit: Continuous spacing precedes the 2m raster; subcell gaps remain explicit in vector geometry.
